required_observations: The current program is an unshipped CLI with no compatibility promise or persistent user data.
File-system configuration, process-global state, printing, and process exit conflict with an embedded library contract.
URL normalization behavior and its edge cases remain useful independently of the CLI architecture.
required_decisions: Use an empty or genesis source baseline in a separate branch or worktree while retaining current HEAD as evidence.
Re-derive or refactor the pure normalization rule and its behavior-facing tests, and discard the CLI and global-state scaffolding from the target.
Make the first vertical a host-callable pure API with explicit input, output, and error behavior plus a forbidden CLI or file-system dependency check.
anti_findings: Do not choose incremental migration merely because current code exists.
Do not preserve printing, process exit, environment variables, or config-file behavior as library compatibility without an owner requirement.
Do not describe deleting or resetting the active tree as rewind.
safety_requirements: Planning remains read-only and preserves the active checkout and Git history.
Any implementation, publication, or deletion remains outside this planning request.
